answer: Every agent voyage begins at a wharf manifest: the agent locks a 2,000 POA bond and files cargo, route and departure slot, signed by the harbor key. At each waypoint, two independent harbor agents verify a nebula drift reading, matching the claimed position against observed telemetry within 50 km. One voyage in six faces a full replay audit; any mismatch burns the 2,000 POA bond and bars the agent from the wharf for 30 days. 100 fake voyages lock 200,000 POA and cost $4,800 in forged drift readings, so a sybil fleet sinks like a smuggler whose logbook disagrees with the lighthouse.
